_meta.name: APAC Cuplock (steel, 125 cm)
_meta.family: Cuplock 1.25-1.30 m, bays 1.8 / 2.5 m (Cuplok type, node 0.50 m)
_meta.note: Cuplock facade scaffold from the APAC catalogue (no article codes in the source: codes are descriptive). Tubular 1.25 m horizontal as transom, steel planks with hooks, cups at 0.5 m, 2.0 m lift. 'verified' = false everywhere.
sources: 168261806-APAC-Scaffold-Formwork-Catalogue.pdf p.21-26 (Cuplock: standards, horizontals, jack p.24; swivel braces, planks, omega transoms p.25; p.26 intermediate transoms, base plate)
168261806-APAC-Scaffold-Formwork-Catalogue.pdf p.36 (Tube & Fitting: drop-forged double coupler, used for the ties)
168261806-APAC-Scaffold-Formwork-Catalogue.pdf p.11 (Kwikstage section: LVL board 38 x 225, 4.7 kg/m, used only as the toeboard rate)
approvals: ISO 9001 (factory) only; no system approval named in the catalogue
changes: Tube printed '48.8x3.2mm' for standards/horizontals (p.24, text layer and page image) and for the hop-up (p.25); the braces on the same page are 48.3x2.5 and no 48.8 mm scaffold tube exists in EN 39 / BS 1139, so tube_od_mm = 48.3 (misprint assumed).
No article codes in the catalogue: descriptive codes CL-STD/CL-H/CL-SP/CL-BR, original text kept in 'note'.
Transom = 1.25 m tubular horizontal (4.93 kg) because the decks are steel planks with hooks; the 1.25 m Omega transom (6.81 kg, p.25) is the alternative for boards/battens.

Plank width is not published (p.25). 230 mm assumed (estimated): the 6.7 kg/m of these planks matches APAC's 230 mm Kwikstage plank (6.8 kg/m, p.11). 5 planks on a 1.25 m transom (1150 mm in 1202 mm clear) - estimated.

Bays 1.8 and 2.5 m (ledger, plank and 2.0 m-high swivel brace all published); 1.5 m as short bay (no brace for 1.5 x 2.0: estimated by the engine at 4.07 kg/m = 1.8x2.0 brace 11.0 kg / 2.7 m). The 3.00 m plank is labelled '(10')' while the 10' ledger is 3.05 m, and there is no 2.0 m ledger for the 2.00 m '(7')' plank, so 3.0/3.05 and 2.0 m bays are left out.
No toeboard in the Cuplock section: the engine estimates toeboards and the end toeboard at 4.7 kg/m (APAC LVL board 38x225, p.11, on edge) - estimated.

Base jack 3.7 kg (p.24) has no published length or travel: length 0.6 m assumed (estimated), travel = 0.68 x length (default ratio). The mass is from the source, so the jack line is not flagged as estimated.
No access deck with hatch (only a 2.5 x 2.0 m staircase, p.26): no access decks are placed.

No wall tie in the Cuplock section: tie tube 0.8 m estimated (48.3 tube at 3.56 kg/m, EN 39 type 3 value), couplers = APAC drop-forged double coupler 0.98 kg (p.36), eyebolt 0.2 kg estimated (Plettac value).
End guard rail = 2 x 1.25 m horizontal (2 x 4.93 kg).

system.width_class: W09 (EN 12811-1), deduced from 5 x 0.23 m (estimated plank width)
system.load_classes_note: not published for the facade; catalogue only claims 57 kN per standard (p.23). Class 3 is a placeholder.
system.connection: Cuplock node: forged blade ends locked by a sliding top cup, cups every 0.5 m, up to 4 members per node (p.22-24)

deck_grade_labels.steel_plank_hooks: Steel plank with hooks (width ~0.23 m, estimated)

labels.end_rail: End guard rail = 2 x horizontal 1.25 m

end_toeboard_74.note: 1.25 m x 4.7 kg/m (APAC LVL board, p.11)

base_plate_threaded.note: Adjustable base jack 3.7 kg (p.24); length 0.6 m estimated, travel from rules.jack_ext_max_ratio

scaffold_tie_80.note: not in the catalogue; 0.8 m of 48.3x3.2 tube at 3.56 kg/m (EN 39 type 3)

eyebolt_120.note: not in the catalogue; Plettac value

sanity_check.description: No catalogue example (kg per m2 or bill of materials) for this system.

rules_verified.note: Nothing in the APAC catalogue on ties, bracing frequency, wall gap or jack travel: all values are the ScaffVisor placeholders. brace_est_mass_per_m = 4.07 from the APAC 1.8x2.0 m brace (11.0 kg / 2.7 m); toeboard_est_kg_per_m = 4.7 from the APAC LVL board 38x225 (p.11). For comparison only (other manufacturer): the SGB Cuplok user guide (339768111, p.2-3, 6-15) asks for a tie at every standard, vertically every 8 m (2 m lifts, pattern A) down to 4.5 m, and one braced bay in every 8 bays (20 m). Not applied here because it is not this manufacturer's document.

rules.note: Indicative rules. Not a substitute for a stability calculation or the manufacturer's instructions.
